test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 10 buckets of water fill a tank when the capacity of each bucket is 14 litres. How many buckets will be needed to fill the same tank, if the capacity of each bucket is 7 litres?
solution:
**Given:**

10 bucket of 14 litres each is used

**Formula used:**

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

**Calculation:**

According to the formula,

⇒ M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

⇒ 10 x 14 = 7 x D₂

⇒ D₂ = 20

**⇒ Hence, Total 20 bucket of 7 l each required**
